description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Bibila, Warakapola, Pradeshiya Sabhas has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacating of offices and declarations by election officials.
